suggestions.title: Hold a Free-Cancellation Black Friday Room Right Now Before Rates Reset
suggestions.idea: Reserve base-Beijing Wangfujing ($425/7N, 51% off Black Friday, free cancel to Feb 14) OR Park Plaza Wangfujing ($749/7N Genius, free cancel to 2 PM Feb 15) plus Pullman Jing'an ($707/7N flex) or Radisson Blu Shanghai ($921/7N flex) immediately.
suggestions.tradeoff: Zero cancellation fee if your dates move; prevents losing $175–$517/week if rooms jump toward mid-March pricing.

suggestions.title: Tour Beijing FIRST (Feb 15–22) and Shanghai SECOND (Feb 22–Mar 1)
suggestions.idea: Doing Beijing in mid-February avoids early-March NPC/CPPCC ('Two Sessions') security closures around Tian'anmen Square, catches Lantern Festival (Sat Feb 20), and locks Beijing's lowest winter hotel rates.
suggestions.tradeoff: Beijing in mid-Feb is colder than mid-March (pack thermal layers & windproof coat), though indoor museums/subways are well heated and crowds are far thinner.

suggestions.title: Consider Splitting or Picking Chaoyang If Fine Dining Outweighs Imperial Sights
suggestions.idea: Because Chaoyang holds 20/33 (60.6%) of Beijing's MICHELIN stars vs Dongcheng's 9/33 (27.3%), Grand Millennium ($783–$838/7N) or Kempinski ($845/7N) puts you steps from 3* Chao Shang Chao, 3* Xin Rong Ji, 1* Cai Yi Xuan, and 1* GIADA Garden — while Park Plaza/base-Beijing maximizes Forbidden City/Wangfujing walkability.
suggestions.tradeoff: Chaoyang adds ~20–30 min subway ride to Forbidden City; Dongcheng adds ~20–30 min subway ride to Chaoyang CBD/Sanlitun dinners.

suggestions.title: Use base-Beijing Wangfujing's In-Unit Washer & Kitchenette as Your Laundry Reset
suggestions.idea: At $425/7N with 570 ft², queen bed, full kitchenette, and private washing machine, base-Beijing lets a 2–4 week couple travel carry-on only and reset laundry before boarding the Shanghai HSR.
suggestions.tradeoff: Serviced apartment format (no swimming pool or 5-star concierge desk; exact metro walk distance should be confirmed on booking).

suggestions.title: Pair High-Value MICHELIN Lunches with 1–2 Signature Tasting Dinners
suggestions.idea: Book 1* Yi Long Court's verified Dim Sum Lunch Set at The Peninsula Shanghai (CNY 596 base / CNY 694.94 all-in for 2), ¥¥ 2* Canton 8 in Shanghai, and ¥¥ 1* Poetry·Wine or The Beijing Kitchen in Beijing alongside your bucket-list 3* splurge.
suggestions.tradeoff: Preserves budget for 3* Xin Rong Ji / 3* Chao Shang Chao / 3* Taian Table without paying ¥¥¥¥ dinner tariffs every night.

suggestions.title: Use Shanghai Museum East (OPEN Mondays!) + Met Jewelry Exhibition as Your Monday Arrival Anchor
suggestions.idea: While Shanghai Museum West, Yu Garden, Da Vittorio, and Sir Elly's are closed Mondays, Shanghai Museum East in Pudong (Line 2) is OPEN Mondays and hosts the Met Museum co-curated 'Jewelry: The Body Transformed' show through 2027-05-05.
suggestions.tradeoff: Closes Tuesdays instead — keep Tuesday for People's Square West Museum & Yu Garden.

suggestions.title: Evaluate Suzhou/Hangzhou Day Trips or Xi'an/Chengdu Before Booking Open-Jaw Flights
suggestions.idea: For a 3–4 week trip, adding 1–2 rail day trips from Shanghai (Suzhou/Hangzhou) or a 4-night Xi'an/Chengdu loop adds huge geographic contrast without flying back and forth.
suggestions.tradeoff: IDEA ONLY — none of Suzhou, Hangzhou, Xi'an, or Chengdu have been verified yet; approve first before we run primary-source hotel/activity verification.
